title: CMP 漿料與磨粒控制
summary: 從磨粒族群、化學與機械分工到批次放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Abrasive populations and Chemical and mechanical roles to Lot release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 磨粒族群 → 稀釋代表性
stages.description: 把「磨粒族群」「數目與強度分布」「稀釋代表性」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Abrasive populations, Number versus intensity distributions, Dilution representativeness.

steps.title: 磨粒族群：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
steps.instruction:
比較相同平均粒徑但不同大粒尾端的兩個假設分布。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設漿料 A 的離散計數為 9,999 顆直徑 100 nm 加 1 顆 1,000 nm，B 為 10,000 顆直徑 100.09 nm。兩者數目加權平均均為 100.09 nm；大於 500 nm 的顆數卻為 A=1、B=0。畫出尾端計數，說明平均值相同仍可能有不同大粒子風險；這不是實際漿料規格，亦不能單由粒徑斷定刮傷。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare hypothetical distributions with equal means but different large-particle tails. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume slurry A contains 9,999 particles of diameter 100 nm and one of 1,000 nm; B contains 10,000 particles of 100.09 nm. Both number-weighted means are 100.09 nm, but counts above 500 nm are A=1 and B=0. Plot tail counts and explain how equal means conceal large-particle differences. These are not slurry specifications, and diameter alone does not establish scratching.
steps.observation: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
steps.observationEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching; Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「磨粒族群」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷。
算例驗收：列出平均值計算及 500 nm 門檻計數；不得把數目加權平均和體積加權平均混用。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Abrasive populations diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
Worked-example acceptance: Show both mean calculations and the 500 nm threshold counts; do not interchange number- and volume-weighted means.

knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume slurry A contains 9,999 particles of diameter 100 nm and one of 1,000 nm; B contains 10,000 particles of 100.09 nm. Both number-weighted means are 100.09 nm, but counts above 500 nm are A=1 and B=0. Plot tail counts and explain how equal means conceal large-particle differences. These are not slurry specifications, and diameter alone does not establish scratching.

quiz.question: 關於「磨粒族群」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Abrasive populations, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷
只用平均粒徑核准漿料
直接疊合強度分布和數目分布比較濃度
optionsEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching
Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone
Comparing concentration by overlaying intensity and number distributions
quiz.explanation: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 磨粒族群：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「磨粒族群」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Abrasive populations artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
steps.observationEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching; Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「磨粒族群」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「尾端估計需足夠取樣體積」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Abrasive populations, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 磨粒族群／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.

knowledge.title: 磨粒族群／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」與「稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone" is not equivalent to "Rare large particles can dominate scratching"; the control must expose their difference.
